summary: Iteration 26 — Verified all 7 new features requested by user (frontend only per E1 note). All 7 PASS end-to-end in Chromium via Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Details: (1) LICENSE GATE: [data-testid=license-key-input] accepts raw chars 'Q61VKG819N40K1BH226T' (controlled reformatter dashes it back to Q61VK-G819N-40K1B-H226T), [data-testid=license-activate-button] activates, [data-testid=legal-agree-checkbox]+[data-testid=legal-accept-button] accept legal, [data-testid=app-header] appears. (2) INSTALL HEADER: [data-testid=install-app-header] visible; click opens [data-testid=install-help-modal] with [data-testid=install-help-steps]; closes via [data-testid=install-help-close]. (3) INSTALL SIDEBAR: [data-testid=install-app-sidebar] visible near bottom of sidebar, click also opens the same install-help modal. (4) STEM ISOLATOR: [data-testid=open-stem-isolator] opens [data-testid=stem-isolator-modal]; when no track, [data-testid=stem-upload-input] accepts a synthesized 2s 22.05kHz mono WAV; four rows render: stem-row-vocals/music/bass/drums; [data-testid=stem-play] toggles playback; per-row controls stem-mute-vocals, stem-solo-vocals, stem-level-vocals work; [data-testid=stem-send-pad-vocals] fires flash 'Vocals sent to Pad 1' via [data-testid=stem-flash] and populates a jingle pad; [data-testid=stem-export-wav-vocals] downloads 'testwav - Vocals.wav'. (5) VOICE BOOTH DSP CHAIN: [data-testid=record-voice-button] (opened after seeding a playlist, since Record Voice is in the TrackList toolbar and requires a current playlist) opens [data-testid=voice-recorder-modal]. [data-testid=voice-fx-chain] panel renders with [data-testid=voice-pad-db] slider present, [data-testid=voice-comp-toggle] toggles reveal [data-testid=voice-comp-threshold]/[data-testid=voice-comp-ratio]/[data-testid=voice-comp-makeup]; [data-testid=voice-gate-toggle] toggles reveal [data-testid=voice-gate-threshold]. No JS errors on toggling on/off. (6) EXPORT IN PARTS: hovering a playlist and clicking [data-testid=export-playlist-{id}] opens [data-testid=export-playlist-modal]. New [data-testid=export-split] checkbox exists (count before toggle=0 for export-part-minutes, after toggle=1 → revealed). Run button label after toggle = 'Save in parts (.zip)'. Running [data-testid=export-run] with the seeded 3s WAV downloaded 'TEST_PartsPL 1 parts 2026-09-22.zip' — .zip flow completes without error. (7) CLOUD HANDOFF: [data-testid=open-cloud-handoff] opens the Cloud Handoff modal. Send-tab description contains '500 MB' (validated via body text). Clicking [data-testid=cloud-upload-button] performs the chunked init/chunk/complete upload (verified via network call) and yields a share code 'TRSFAF' in [data-testid=cloud-share-code]. Progress bar [data-testid=cloud-upload-progress] was not visually captured because the empty-studio payload is ~0.0 MB and completes in <1 chunk (the fast-path skips the visible progress state); this is expected for tiny payloads — the code path in lib/api.js uploadShowChunked still traverses init→chunk→complete as confirmed by the resulting share-code page. Non-blocking: pre-existing hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from visual-editor injection persists (carry-over from iter 20-25).

issues: Carry-over: visual-editor injects <span> into <option>, producing a React hydration warning. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Nit) Cloud Handoff [data-testid=cloud-upload-progress] only appears mid-transfer; for empty/near-empty studios the chunked upload completes before React renders the progress bar. Consider always rendering the progress element (even briefly at 0%/100%) so automated tests can observe it. Not user-facing.
(Carry-over) Remove visual-editor <span>-in-<option> injection in PlayerBar to clear hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: StemIsolator.js: modal is proper z-50 fixed overlay; verified Escape doesn't close it — only the X button does. That's fine but consider adding Escape-to-close for a11y/keyboard flow.
VoiceRecorder buildMicChain / voice-fx-chain: comp+gate toggles gate behind boolean state, revealed testids appear/disappear correctly. No orphan AudioNode leaks observed on rapid toggle.

Sidebar.js:216 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 — save/export/schedule per-playlist icons rely on parent :hover; Playwright must click with force=True or force opacity via JS. Consider making them focus-visible so keyboard/tab users see them too.

ExportPlaylistModal split checkbox + export-part-minutes revealed on toggle; run label switches to 'Save in parts (.zip)' correctly. exportPlaylistInParts produces a valid .zip with one part for a 3s payload (30-min default cap).

lib/api.js uploadShowChunked returns a share code end-to-end; progress callback fires, but for near-zero-byte payloads the UI transitions from 'idle → success' before the progress DOM node mounts. Consider mounting the progress element as soon as the button is clicked (progress=0) instead of after first chunk.
InstallButton fallback modal correctly opens when beforeinstallprompt isn't captured (headless Chromium). data-testids install-help-modal/steps/close are stable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 7 targeted features (License, Install-header, Install-sidebar, Stem Isolator, Voice Booth DSP chain, Export in parts, Cloud Handoff 500MB+chunked).

test_credentials: Offline activation key Q61VK-G819N-40K1B-H226T (typed raw as 'Q61VKG819N40K1BH226T' — the controlled input reformats to dashes).
seed_data_creation: Playlist 'TEST_PartsPL' with one synthesized 3s 22.05kHz mono WAV track (via [data-testid=add-files-input]) to exercise export-in-parts. Playlist 'TEST_VoicePL' created earlier to enable Record Voice button. Cloud share code TRSFAF (empty studio) generated as an incidental artefact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 features work. Key gotchas for future runs: (a) Record Voice button [data-testid=record-voice-button] lives in TrackList toolbar and is only visible when a playlist is selected; create a playlist first. (b) The sidebar per-playlist export button is [data-testid=export-playlist-{uuid}] and is opacity:0 until parent :hover — Playwright must .evaluate opacity or use force=True; DO NOT confuse with the TrackList toolbar's [data-testid=export-playlist-button] which is 'Share Show' (.hl95playout). (c) StemIsolator modal doesn't close on Escape — only the X button. (d) Voice DSP toggles [data-testid=voice-comp-toggle]/[data-testid=voice-gate-toggle] are inline buttons — after toggling on, comp reveals threshold/ratio/makeup; gate reveals threshold. (e) Cloud Handoff progress bar may not visibly appear for near-zero-byte studios; presence of [data-testid=cloud-share-code] is the reliable success signal.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. First script run missed the Voice Recorder because [data-testid=record-voice-button] requires a selected playlist, and missed Export-in-parts because I clicked the TrackList's [data-testid=export-playlist-button] (Share Show) instead of the sidebar [data-testid=export-playlist-{id}]. Re-run with seeded playlist + track and correct selector confirmed both features work.
